title: Looking to make a TCG Battler!
author: Synapnoid
selftext: Hey everyone! So for my own project I think I'm looking to   AI to make artwork for cards and go for a more sci-fi themed Battler! Does anyone have any experience and tips for this, like what would be the easiest dev system to use and all that please? Gemini says GODOT for a card game! 👋😅🤔

comments.author: LatentBlade
comments.body: I am making a deckbuilder roguelike in Godot. Scope creep is really hard to avoid in a card game (just one more mechanic!). I started by designing my card  layouts in gimp before the image generators were good. Then nano banana pro changed me because I could give my current layouts and ask it to make them good. There are some good godot deck builder tutorials. I suggest starting there even if you plan to vibe code. I still believe the more you know the better the LLM assistant will do for you.

comments.author: IAmhowlshot
comments.body:
I'm making a triple triad clone in godot with over 100+ uniquely generated character cards. I fought with chatgpt and Gemini for two months to get styling right. 
I do not recommend making things very intricate to start with. 
Get your core gameplay loop down before creating art, and don't spend too long making the art lol.

replies.author: IAmhowlshot
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/wj9ik9eve9vg1.png?width=524&format=png&auto=webp&s=20bf0edc5d7d089aba2a42124ddb1b51a399b754

For cards like this, I generated the border on its own, the banners on their own, and the base art on its own. Then i combined it all in PS, the numbers and text are created by script at runtime.
